sentences.text:
Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.419/2024 registered at Police Station- Shahpur, District-Burhanpur (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 294, 323, 506, 376-AB, 376-D,
450, 307, 190 of the IPC and Section 5M/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case due to enmity over land dispute.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.

3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:60365 2 MCRC-52775-2024 opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is minor girl aged 10 years and applicant has committed ghastly act with her.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.
On going through the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C., it is found that she has stated that mother told her that applicant had committed raper on her.
In medical report, no definite opinion was given by doctor regarding rape.

(b) that such person shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected of the commission of which he is suspected and;
(c) that such person shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
